description: Burkina Faso's only MiG-17F, a combat veteran of the 1985-86 Agacher Strip War against Mali, mounted on a landscaped and planted island inside the Ouagadougou air base. Recorded as preserved with a 22 December 2025 update, and a white swept-wing jet sits on the green island on Esri WorldView-3 0.31 m imagery acquired 10 December 2025.
